report.summary: No blocking findings; the change can merge. Probes confirmed that bun build --env inlines only process.env.TEMPO_BUILD_ID (dot form), so the tempod VERSION fix is correct, and that Bun.spawn detached:true gives the child its own process group, so killing the group in ci.ts also reaches grandchildren. ci-cache.ts fails safe: nothing is pruned when a summary can't be read, when no task hashes are found, or after a failed run. It reads .turbo/runs summaries, which Turbo 2.11.7's bundled docs describe, and only .turbo/cache is restored, so old summaries never return. The Dockerfile's secret mounts are optional, so building every deploy without TEMPO_BUILD_CA works. Every RPC the forge demo calls exists in the protocol, and its expectations (PR_NOT_MERGEABLE on reopening a merged PR, check-run names, the merge gate) match the specs and code. Unit tests, typecheck, lint and format pass. Not run: the real CI workflow, the deploy, and the live demo.

findings.text: The baked-image check greps the binary for buildId. Without a git commit, buildId falls back to the bare version (e.g. 0.1.0), and a plain substring search for that could match unrelated text and pass wrongly. With git present, the id is unique (version+sha). Not blocking.

evidence.why: buildId is `sha ? ... : version`; with no git sha the search string is a short version number that may appear elsewhere in the binary.

findings.text: watch.close() runs only on the success path, so a failed assertion leaves the workspace socket open until the process ends. This only affects the live demo, which CI does not run. Not blocking.

evidence.why: It is not in a finally block or afterEach.

checked.risk: Real contracts: Bun build env inlining, Bun.spawn detached process groups, Turbo run-summary location and fields, Dockerfile optional secret mounts, protocol RPC names
Failure paths: pruning fails safe on unreadable summaries or failed checks; deploy fails if the image lacks the build id; group kill ignores ESRCH
Idempotency and state: cache save only on new entries, using mtimes compared against the restore marker; per-run archive key
Security: no secrets in logs; CA passed only as a BuildKit secret; e2e uses existing token flow
Build and runtime environment: tempod binary path and owner in the image; Bun 1.4.2 behavior
Tests: ci-cache unit tests assert observable results, including the fail-safe case; e2e uses waitFor polling rather than sleeps
Spec: CI.md, deployment doc and IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES updated; demo expectations match 02/09/10 and the code
